title: Call for Papers — Special Issue: Living with ChatGPT
body: JCEA invites submissions for a special issue on generative AI in East Asian societies, guest-edited by Weiwen Yu and Chun Shao. See the Call for Papers page for the full scope and timeline.

title: JCEA at the Triple Helix Conference 2025, Monterrey
body: The World Association for Triple Helix and Future Strategy Studies (WATEF) co-hosted sessions at the Triple Helix Conference, October 28–31, 2025 in Monterrey, Mexico. Selected papers will be invited to submit to JCEA.

title: Best Paper Award 2020–2021
body: Congratulations to Seok Kang, whose article “Framing North Korea on Twitter: Is Network Strength Related to Sentiment?” received the JCEA Best Paper Award. See the Best Paper page for past awardees.

title: CFP: Digital Transformations in Asian Politics
body: A special issue on digital technologies, AI and democracy in Asia, guest-edited by Justin Chun-ting Ho and Dechun Zhang. Abstracts were due November 29, 2024. Read the call (PDF).

title: 2026 JCEA Summer Workshop: The Triple Helix, Socio-Technical Convergence, and New Asian Studies
body: WATEF and the Cyber Emotions Research Institute host the 2026 JCEA Summer Workshop on July 28–29, 2026, in Korean and English. See the workshop page for details and the brochure.

title: Data papers as a model: a conversation between JOHD and KISTI
body: The Journal of Open Humanities Data talks with KISTI, JCEA’s indexing and preservation partner, about data papers as a publishing model. Read the conversation.

title: Preview: JCEA's new website
body: The Journal of Contemporary Eastern Asia is moving to a new website. You are viewing a preview at a temporary test address (hanji.lampbotics.com/jcea), which is for testing only. The journal's official website is and remains jceasia.org, which currently shows the existing site. In 2027 jceasia.org will switch over to this new site, so the address stays the same and existing bookmarks and links will keep working. The new site brings together every issue since 2018, the full editorial board, current calls for papers and expanded policy pages. Full texts remain on KoreaScience and all DOIs are unchanged; manuscripts are still submitted through ACOMS+. Feedback is welcome at j.c.eastern.asia@gmail.com.
